description: distort repeat WITHOUT the timestretch: each wavecycle (group) still plays multiplier times, but the program skips ahead correspondingly so the output stays the input's length - the granular 'freeze-stutter' color of repeat at the original duration. Duration static within ~1% on tones and flat noise (1.9976 at x3, 2.0182 at x12, 2.0038 flat noise); slightly OVER input at high multipliers (repeated groups re-quantise). multiplier and cyclecnt both breakpoint-capable (each verified against both scalar endpoints). Deterministic. MONO only.
musical_use: Pitch-bead granulation in place: the sound's timeline is preserved while its surface becomes repeating micro-loops - like a granular freeze that keeps walking forward. Because material is skipped to compensate for the repeats, higher multipliers make the output sparser and more robotic: x3 reads as roughness/flange, x12 as overt stutter sampling every 12th group. Raise cyclecnt to make each repeated unit long enough to hear as a pitch bead (noise -> pitched stutter, the repeat-family trick, without the length change). Breakpoint the multiplier to move between intact and heavily-frozen across the file - the duration stays put, so it layers perfectly against the dry source.

multiplier.description: Times each wavecycle-group repeats; the read pointer skips ahead to keep the length static (CDP-enforced 2-32767: 1 refused verbatim). Breakpoint-capable, banner-confirmed and verified (2->12 ramp differs from both endpoint renders; length still ~2.0).

cyclecnt.description: Wavecycles per repeated group (default 1). Larger groups -> audibly looping beads. Breakpoint-capable (verified: -c 2->8 ramp differs from both -c2 and -c8 renders).

skipcycles.description: Wavecycles to skip at the file start - DROPPED from the output (verified: -s100 on a 440 Hz tone -> 1.7727 s, minus ~100/440 s), so the static model assumes 0. Scalar only: brk refused 'Cannot read parameter 3 ... brkpnt_files not permitted.'

examples.expected_use: Every cycle triples but the timeline holds - flangey, robotic surface; layers cleanly under the dry sound.
32-cycle groups repeat 8x while sampling ever-sparser source material; noise becomes stuttering pitched beads at the original length.

known_issues: skipcycles drops material from the output (model assumes 0).
Unipolar / zero-crossing-free material refused: 'ERROR: CANNOT ACHIEVE TASK: / ERROR: source sound too short to attempt this process.'
Stereo refused: 'Application doesn't work with this type of infile.' (exit 255) -> mono.
Deterministic (repeat runs byte-identical). Duration drifts slightly ABOVE input at high multipliers (+0.9% at x12) - re-quantised group lengths; budget the row tolerance accordingly.
